picks.what: Saarbrücken Castle, engraving in Merian’s Topographia Palatinatus Rheni
picks.why: only genuine period view; bird’s-eye view of the castle above the Saar, trimmed from a book page that also shows Philippsborn

gaps: P0, P2–P6: nothing usable (most candidates are other places held in the Saarland archive: Nancy, Münstermaifeld, Cochem, Luxembourg, Mulhouse; modern ones are aerials of the airport, prison and an industrial park)
notes: Castle view, not the whole town; drop it if a town view is required. One catalog record suggests this copy of the Topographia may be the 1672 reissue; 1645 is the first edition year.
